name: The Adventurer
summary: From Red Cloud Mesa, Chief Hawkwind sends young travelers with supplies for Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village. She aided him long ago, and he means to repay her kindness.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Repayment
sections.body: Chief Hawkwind asks you to carry provisions to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village. Long ago, she helped him when he was in need, and he remembers her kindness. Now she has made camp outside the village. So Hawkwind entrusts young travelers leaving the mesa with supplies for his old benefactor.

sections.title: Leaving the Mesa
sections.body: The trail runs from Red Cloud Mesa toward Bloodhoof Village, across the plains of Mulgore. With Hawkwind's bundle, you travel beyond Camp Narache, where young tauren have trained. The path leads into the wider lands of the United Tauren Tribes.

faq.answer: Kaga Wildhoof is a seasoned tauren adventurer camped just outside Bloodhoof Village. She aided Chief Hawkwind in the past.

faq.q: Why does Chief Hawkwind send these supplies?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind sends the supplies to repay Kaga Wildhoof for the help she gave him long ago.

faq.q: Where is Kaga Wildhoof's camp located?
faq.answer: Kaga Wildhoof's camp is just outside Bloodhoof Village, down the path from Red Cloud Mesa into central Mulgore.

faq.q: When does this quest become available?
aliases: when do i get the adventurer
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind offers this work when you have proven yourself on Red Cloud Mesa and are ready to travel into Mulgore.

faq.q: Does this quest take you away from Camp Narache?
faq.answer: Yes. You carry the supplies from Camp Narache down the trail toward Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: What is contained within the Supply Bundle?
faq.answer: The Supply Bundle holds essential supplies for an adventurer traveling beyond the settlements.

angles.text: As a young tauren, you carry Hawkwind's supplies to Kaga Wildhoof beyond Camp Narache and into the plains of Mulgore.
As a Horde traveler leaving Red Cloud Mesa, you carry supplies to Kaga Wildhoof, an experienced wanderer near Bloodhoof Village.
